name: Short 6 - microsoft_sale
script: By 2012, Samsung had overtaken Nokia as the world's biggest phone maker, ending a fourteen year run. In September 2013, Microsoft agreed to buy Nokia's devices and services business for about five point four billion euros. The deal closed in April 2014. Then, in July 2015, Microsoft took a seven point six billion dollar write down and cut around seven thousand eight hundred jobs from the division. Microsoft lost more on Nokia than Nokia made selling it.
